source.title: Solutions to four open problems concerning controlled pure grammar systems

trace.notes: Normalized the single input as a zbMATH resolver URL with trailing identifier 6355133. Direct local shell fetch of the zbMATH record failed because outbound DNS resolution is unavailable in the sandbox.

Local resolver rows identified the exact work as 'Solutions to four open problems concerning controlled pure grammar systems' with DOI 10.1080/00207160.2013.829214, OpenAlex work https://openalex.org/W1995216040, Crossref DOI 10.1080/00207160.2013.829214, and DBLP key journals/ijcm/MedunaVZ14.

Classified the access failure as metadata_only with network_or_dns_failure for local shell fetching. Bounded exact-work recovery attempted the zbMATH URL, zbMATH API/document endpoint, DOI/Taylor & Francis landing paths, DBLP DOI and unpaywalled resolver links, OpenAlex/Crossref metadata rows, ResearchGate, the authors' VUT publication listings, and exact-title searches with PDF and author terms.

Rejected recovered candidates because they did not provide a readable exact-work primary source: zbMATH, DBLP, OpenAlex, Crossref, and VUT pages exposed bibliographic metadata; ResearchGate exposed an abstract and reported no full text; DOI/Taylor & Francis full-text or PDF pages were not readable through the available fetch paths; exact-title searches returned only metadata, abstracts, publication lists, or snippets.

No candidate question was extracted because the source adequacy gate failed: resolver metadata, abstracts, search snippets, and publication listings are not acceptable technical evidence when the exact-work PDF or full HTML source is unavailable.
Saved final JSON to outputs/parse-paper/6355133.json and outputs/latest.json.
